Name: FullHunt
Author: FullHunt - team@fullhunt.io
Description:
The [FullHunt](https://fullhunt.io) solution for Microsoft Sentinel brings your external attack surface into Microsoft Sentinel so you can monitor, hunt and respond to changes in it.

**Data connectors** ingest FullHunt attack surface alerts (new subdomains, exposed ports, DNS and certificate changes, discovered vulnerabilities), vulnerabilities, certificate-derived domains, suggested domains, and, with the FullHunt Dark Web Monitoring module, typosquatting and potential phishing domains.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technologies, and some of these dependencies either may be in [Preview](https://azure.microsoft.com/support/legal/preview-supplemental-terms/) state or might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

a. [Azure Monitor Logs: DCR-based Custom Logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/logs-ingestion-api-overview)

b. [Codeless Connector Framework (CCF)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/create-codeless-connector)
